subject: 寫入範圍改成「白名單只是建議、黑名單才擋」:allowed_write_paths 用於排平行與提醒覆核者,越出只記錄不擋;只有票的 out_of_scope 與 config 的 protected_paths 硬擋
objective: 使用者 2026-09-28 裁示(D-H38 ①,取代兩層方案):開票不再限制實作者只能改哪些檔。allowed_write_paths 保留但降為「預期會動的檔」——排順序的人拿它判平行、覆核者拿它對照;apply.sh/land 對越出白名單的檔不再 rc=5,而是列進 result json 的 extra_paths 與覆核派工文的「白名單外改動:逐檔確認與票面目標相關、測試沒改弱(斷言數不減、刪案例要有票面理由),無關或改弱 = fail」段。硬擋只剩兩種:票的 out_of_scope 明列的路徑(glob)、board/config.json 的 protected_paths(專案自訂;tabby_pool 預設 docs/DECISIONS.md、scripts/build.sh、scripts/deploy-prod.sh、demo/data/**)。反駁類別 paths-only 廢除;實作者角色卡改成「要改就改、EVIDENCE 列出白名單外的每個檔與理由」。稽核 docs/review/20260928-flow-waste-audit.md R3/R4(tabby_pool)。
acceptance: tests:改動含 allowed_write_paths 外、且不在 out_of_scope/protected_paths 的檔 → apply rc==0,result.extra_paths 列出該檔
tests:改動命中票 out_of_scope 或 config protected_paths → apply rc==5,訊息點名該檔與擋它的是哪一格
tests:有 extra_paths → dispatch-reviewer.md 含「白名單外改動」段與每個檔名;沒有 → 沒這段
tests:config 沒有 protected_paths、票沒有 out_of_scope → 任何檔都不擋(只記錄)
memory/role/implementer.md 有「白名單外的檔要改就改、EVIDENCE 列出」一句且刪掉 paths-only 反駁;tickets/SCHEMA.md 的 allowed_write_paths 說明改成「預期會動的檔,不是限制」並記 protected_paths 來自 board/config.json
outline: needs_verifier=false:框架腳本票,tests/ 裡的單元測試就是驗收,實作者自證變異紅(依 A #43/#48 慣例)。稽核來源:tabby_pool docs/review/20260928-flow-waste-audit.md;裁示 D-H38。

objections.body: allowed_write_paths lacks scripts/gate.sh, scripts/land.sh, scripts/ticket.py — the objective (land stops refusing extras) needs land.sh, and gate.sh preflight rc=4 would refuse every branch apply now lets through; ticket.py holds the one shared write_scope(). Current main apply.sh will rc=5 on them; widen with: python3 scripts/ticket.py set 59 allowed_write_paths '["scripts/apply.sh", "scripts/review.sh", "scripts/auto-fix.sh", "memory/role/implementer.md", "tickets/SCHEMA.md", "board/*", "tests/*", "scripts/gate.sh", "scripts/land.sh", "scripts/ticket.py"]'
objections.follow_up: 主線裁示:接受。gate.sh 的 preflight、land.sh 的越界拒收、ticket.py 的 write_scope() 都是同一條規則的三個出口,一起改;allowed_write_paths 加 scripts/gate.sh、scripts/land.sh、scripts/ticket.py。
